howto.name: Upload a JPG
howto.text: Select a JPEG file from camera, phone, or web.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. PrivaTools encodes the image as WebP, typically saving 25–35% in file size at the same visual quality.

faq.a: WebP files are typically 25–35% smaller than JPGs at the same visual quality. That speeds up page loads and saves bandwidth, especially for image-heavy sites.
Yes — every major browser supports WebP since 2020 (Chrome, Firefox, Safari 14+, Edge). For maximum compatibility with very old browsers or email clients, use JPG.
It can be either. Our default is lossy WebP for best compression. Lossless WebP is also supported but produces larger files.
